mission: 把可直接服務中文閱讀者的外文長文本提升為 Work candidates；不把 Scripture/commentary 資料重新灌入黎明書局。

observedSourceStructure.note: Open Christian Data 已把 church-fathers、devotionals、doctrinal-documents、sermons、catechisms 等與 bible-text/commentaries 分開；本批優先 structured-text 中完整、可識別、非 Scripture 本體的教父作品。

candidates.title: On the Duties of the Clergy
candidates.author: Ambrose of Milan

dedupStrategy.workKey: normalized author + normalized historical work title + work-kind
dedupStrategy.editionRule: NPNF/CCEL English translation remains an Edition/source relation, not the canonical Work identity.
dedupStrategy.rule: A Greek/Latin witness and an English public-domain translation must converge on one canonical Work when they represent the same historical work; they become language/edition witnesses under that Work.

sourceWitnessUpgrade.principle: Where a Greek or Latin source witness exists, preserve it alongside the English translation. Dawn Library may then offer original-language witness, readable English witness and generated zh-Hant without manufacturing separate Works.
sourceWitnessUpgrade.qualityGate: OCR/raw machine-corrected witnesses are evidence/source candidates, not automatically reader-authority editions. Record OCR quality and provenance before exposing them as preferred original text.

exclude: commentaries whose primary product role belongs to ONE/Bible-world
bibleBoundary.allow: Patristic/theological works may contain Scripture quotations and references; that does not make the work a Bible text.

facets.translationState: 可即時繁中 after rights/provenance gate
